description: Header file defining a set of functions and templates for reading from and writing to shared file descriptors, including handling of binary data and socket communication. It includes functions for reading exact amounts of data, reading binary data, and writing data with error handling.

methods.name: ReadAll
methods.description: Reads from a SharedFD until it is closed or errors, storing all data in the provided buffer and returning the number of bytes read or -1 on error.

methods.name: ReadExact
methods.description: Reads exactly buf->size() bytes from SharedFD into the buffer, returning the number of bytes read or -1 on error.

methods.name: ReadExact
methods.description: Overload reading into a vector of chars, reads exactly buf->size() bytes.

methods.name: ReadExact
methods.description: Reads exactly size bytes from SharedFD into a char buffer, returning number of bytes read or -1 on error.

methods.name: ssize_t ReadExactBinary(SharedFD fd,T * binary_data)
methods.description: Templated function to read exactly sizeof(T) bytes into a binary data structure.

methods.name: WriteAll
methods.description: Writes all bytes from a string view to SharedFD, returning number of bytes written or -1 on error.

methods.name: WriteAll
methods.description: Writes all bytes from a vector of chars to SharedFD, returning number of bytes written or -1 on error.

methods.name: WriteAll
methods.description: Writes size bytes from a const char* buffer to SharedFD, returning number of bytes written or -1 on error.

methods.name: ssize_t WriteAllBinary(SharedFD fd,const T * binary_data)
methods.description: Templated function to write binary data of type T, returning sizeof(T) or -1 on error.

methods.name: SendAll
methods.description: Sends the entirety of a message through a socket, returning true on success or false on error.

methods.name: RecvAll
methods.description: Receives a specified number of bytes from a socket, returning a string with received data or an empty string on error.
